source.note: Captures document this delivery while it was being built. The saved-run still precedes the final singular-run and refresh-error copy fixes. The before-layout still deliberately shows the baseline layout. File hashes below identify the final reviewed implementation, not every earlier screenshot.

capture.data: Temporary isolated directories for all eight stores; real game runs generated for this capture. No private user history was imported.
capture.screenshots: Native browser captures, with JPEG-to-PNG conversion where needed. No page content was composited or retouched. Mobile capture uses an explicit 390 x 844 CSS-pixel viewport clip.
capture.gif: Timestamped browser screencast frames resampled to 12 fps and palette-encoded with ffmpeg; no time acceleration, added frames or audio. Full duration 16.000 seconds.

interactionChecks: Start and stop local run; save to temporary storage
Play sampled replay and pause it
Section navigation jumps to review controls
Space on focused navigation does not start the game
Failed refresh retains rows with a previous-results warning
Failed selection gives actionable local-server guidance
Refresh after server return clears both warnings and shows the fresh empty store

media.caption: Before the navigation and ordering fix: comparison controls occupied the area immediately below the game.
The first 16 seconds of a real local rule-based run, at normal speed.
A real local rule-based run in progress. No Mubit inference was used.
The 390 CSS-pixel responsive layout following the recorded run.
After the layout fix: section navigation, game, local play controls and saved-run list.
The final failed-refresh and failed-selection guidance, with the previously loaded row clearly labelled.
An empty correction workflow showing that Mubit training is not verified.
The recorded score245 run and sampled replay controls. The screenshot precedes the later singular-run wording fix.

limits: Local rule-based gameplay is not Mubit-controlled gameplay.
Empty review panels demonstrate state labelling, not completed provider review or training.
No new provider comparison, quality improvement, token saving or hosted model update was measured.
Sampled replay consists of saved screenshots; it is not continuous recorded video.
GIF visual review sampled the first, middle and last seconds; the entire file also passed decoding.
Responsive checks are browser viewport checks, not physical-device certification.
This is not a complete accessibility or cross-browser audit.
